framework_note: PIT cutoff 2023-01-15 precedes the FY26 J-Book publication (June 2025) by ~2.5 years. The pentagon_jbook corpus is hand-extracted from FY26 PB exhibits, so all PE history rows fall AFTER cutoff and the timerange filter returns NOT_FOUND_IN_TIMERANGE for every J-Book-grounded claim. Per heuristic #1 / #7, these are UNVERIFIABLE — not negative signals. This is a structural coverage gap, not a divergence catch. The J-Book PIT framework is best applied when the cutoff is AFTER the latest J-Book year covered by the corpus; for a 2023-01-15 cutoff, the appropriate Pentagon document is the FY23 / FY24 PB (Mar-2022 / Mar-2023 release) which is not in the corpus.

scores.claim_text: L3Harris is a primary contractor on the SDA Tracking Layer program (space payloads / full-mission solutions).
scores.M_value: NOT_FOUND_IN_TIMERANGE (corpus is FY26 PB; cutoff is pre-FY24 PB)
supports: Corpus does corroborate forward LHX participation: contractor_name='L3 Harris' returns Tranche 3 Tracking Layer PWSA (PE 1206410SF) with declared status FUNDED_STEADY, and LHX listed as one of four primes (Lockheed, Northrop, L3 Harris, Rocket Lab) — but the funding rows fall after cutoff
At PIT 2023-01-15 SDA had only awarded Tranche 0 (T0) and Tranche 1 (T1) contracts; Tranche 3 had not yet been competed

Note: PE 1206410SF Tranche 3 TRANSPORT (separate program at same PE) is declared UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS in the latest J-Book — but LHX is NOT a Transport prime per corpus; LHX is on the Tracking Layer side which is FUNDED_STEADY
scores.interpretation: The narrative-load-bearing claim ('we are positioned as a Tracking Layer prime') is structurally not falsifiable from the FY26-only corpus at a 2023-01-15 cutoff. Latest J-Book status_declared is mildly positive for LHX (Tracking Layer steady). No divergence signal.

supports: USAspending materially confirms LHX received the DoD revenue stream they claim — orthogonal verification of the rear-view
FY26 J-Book PE 0605031F (JTN) exists in corpus but pre-cutoff funding rows absent
Tactical-radio claim is not contradicted by any J-Book signal
scores.interpretation: USAspending strongly corroborates the historical revenue base; forward J-Book check is unverifiable due to corpus coverage. Net: PASS — the company's claimed DoD revenue concentration is real and the program family is still resourced in the latest J-Book per status_declared.

summary.framework_finding: The pentagon_jbook FY26-corpus cannot evaluate divergence at a 2023-01-15 PIT — all primary verifier outputs collapse to NOT_FOUND_IN_TIMERANGE / null status. Per heuristic #1 + #7, severity is correctly downgraded to UNVERIFIABLE rather than spuriously RED-flagging the company. The framework's blinding discipline is intact: no post-cutoff information was used; the corpus-coverage limit was respected.
